title: plastic shower curtain
text: plastic shower curtain. I thought I had purchased a lovely cloth sheer shower curtain - they totally cheap plastic. They look cheap and feel like cheap plastic. YUCK.  Very disappointed.  Hopefully my review will help others understand what they are getting!  Returned.

product_metadata.title: Excell Ivy 1, 70" X 72", Silver
features: PEVA SHOWER CURTAIN: Made from 100% commercial grade PEVA, the Ivy Shower Curtain is chlorine and PVC free for safe home use. Premium quality curtain will stay clean and fresh for long

IVY SHOWER CURTAIN: Excell’s Home Fashions Ivy shower curtain features a beautiful botanical leaf pattern enhanced with metallic accents. This beautiful and sleek curtain will perfectly fit your bathroom shower or bathtub area perfectly

WATER-REPELLENT SHOWER CURTAIN: Made from 100% PEVA, this non- toxic shower curtain is water repellent. This strong and durable shower curtain will keep the water in the tub, away from the bathroom floor. No need for a separate liner

METAL GROMMETS: The 100% PEVA Ivy Shower Curtain features 12 rust resistant metal grommets to prevent tearing and ensure durability. The shower curtain can be used as stand alone or with a curtain liner

DECORATIVE SHOWER CURTAIN: Style your bathroom/home décor with a botanical themed shower curtain. The Ivy Shower Curtain measures 70” x 72” and will fit into most standard bathrooms. Includes 1 PEVA Shower Curtain
description: Dress up the bathroom with Excell Home Fashions 100% PEVA Ivy Shower Curtain featuring metallic accents highlighting a pretty botanical pattern. The Ivy PEVA shower curtain is soft to the touch and drapes beautifully. Made from 100% commercially graded PEVA material, the shower curtain is strong and long lasting, includes rust-resistant metal grommets. The thick, water-resistant PEVA Shower Curtain will protect the bathroom floor from water splashes, keeping it clean and dry. Care Instruction: Wipe with a damp cloth to clean. Measures 70” x 72”, includes 1 shower curtain.
